paper.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (3rd ed.)
paper.section: §4.3.2 — AND-OR search trees for nondeterministic/partially observable vacuum worlds; conditional plans of the form [if-then-else]
paper.claim: With dirt status unknown, no unconditional plan is guaranteed; AND-OR search returns the conditional plan 'sense dirt; if dirty then suck else nothing', which achieves the goal in every possible initial world.
